text:
Nora: thinking out loud 1 - we need a 'quorumed-wave' config primitive that requires statistical significance checks between baseline and cohort before promoting. reduces noisy rollbacks.

Anya: UI needs to show confidence intervals + an explicit "pass/fail" for each check. make the graph interactive so PMs can hover windows.

Bryan: API idea - `waves: [{pct, duration_mins, min_samples, significance_level, checks}]` where `significance_level` is alpha (e.g., 0.05). also `cost_estimate_delta` field returned by dry-run.

Leo: ops: require a circuit-backoff when infra capacity approaches threshold. e.g., if GPU_util>85% in cohort region, pause next wave and notify ops.

Raj: telemetry: tag requests with `wave_id` and `wave_seed`. emit aggregated test_results per wave: {metric, baseline_mean, cohort_mean, p_value, passed}. include a linkable trace id for failed waves. keep metric cardinality low.

Sumi: policy proposal: default rollback if any required check fails at alpha=0.01 for 3 consecutive windows; opt-in looser alpha for low-impact changes. also require `manual_override` gate with TTL for safety.

Anya: console UX: timeline + CI charts, a small "explain failure" modal that surfaces the raw math (delta, p-value, sample sizes), and a one-click snapshot revert. add keyboard shortcuts for pause/abort.

Bryan: sample schema snippet: ```json
{"id":"qwave-2026","waves":[{"pct":5,"duration_mins":15,"min_samples":500,"significance_level":0.01,"checks":["p95<200"]}],"dry_run":true}
```

Leo: implementer note - compute p-values in streaming aggregator; avoid full re-aggregation. use Wilson score for proportions and bootstrap for heavy-tailed latencies.

Raj: include a `wave_health` timeseries and a dashboard template. also bump trace sampling for failing waves and tag alerts with wave_id.

deploy-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4782 - add quorumed-wave proto + dashboard spork. CI: 705 unit, integration flaky on stats-sim.

Nora: volunteers for RFC: Bryan (api), Raj (telemetry), Anya (ux), Leo (ops). i'll draft RFC with test harness outline. ping here for reviews. :rocket:
